::: {#def-exposure-mapping .theorem}
## Exposure mapping

A function $g_{ik} : \mathcal R(\mathbf X_1) \times \dots \times \mathcal R(\mathbf X_{k-1}) \times \mathcal R(\mathbf X_{k,<i}) \times \mathcal R(\boldsymbol\psi_1) \times \dots \times \mathcal R(\boldsymbol\psi_T) \to \mathbb{R}^m$ that selects and transforms the parents of a variable from the variables that precede it:

$$
X_{ki} = f_{X_{ki}}\big(g_{ik}(\mathbf{X}_1,\dots,\mathbf{X}_{k-1}, \mathbf X_{k,<i}, \boldsymbol\psi_1, \dots, \boldsymbol\psi_T),\, U_{X_{ki}}\big) = f_{X_{ki}}\big(\mathbf{Pa}(X_{ki}),\, U_{X_{ki}}\big),
$$

where $\mathcal R(\cdot)$ is the range, $\mathbf X_1,\dots,\mathbf X_{k-1}$ are the [covariates](#def-covariate) that precede $X_{ki}$ in [topological order](#def-dag), $\mathbf X_{k,<i}$ the elements of its own covariate that precede it, and $\boldsymbol\psi_1, \dots, \boldsymbol\psi_T$ the [graph generators](#def-npsem-ne) that precede it. With a fixed network there are no graph generators.
:::
